description: Durable narrative facts extracted from Story.premise + Story.opening_message at authoring time. Output populates Story.seed_facts, which is bulk-inserted into the adventure's pgvector facts store at adventure creation. Downstream: world consistency check + narrator both retrieve by embedding similarity.

fields.facts: array of fact objects. Each entry: { text (string — one self-contained sentence), kind ('event' | 'state' | 'entity'), entities (array of proper-noun strings the fact references — e.g. ['Vren', 'Thornfield']; [] if none), polarity ('asserts' | 'negates') }.
fields.reasoning: string — one short sentence on the extraction call, for audit.

kinds.event: Something that happened in story history. e.g. 'the bridge collapsed last week'.
kinds.state: A current condition. e.g. 'the village is under curfew'.
kinds.entity: An NPC, object, or location the narrative establishes. e.g. 'the antagonist is named Vren'.
